definitions: To remove all coverings or clothes from someone or something.
To remove a layer of paint, varnish, or other coating from a surface.
To remove components or parts from a machine or device.
To deprive someone of property, titles, or rights.
To tear or damage the thread of a screw or nut.
examples: They decided to strip the old wallpaper.
The car was stripped for parts.
He was stripped of his medals.
The mechanic had to strip down the engine.
Be careful not to strip the screw.
